data.title: 新条茜 · 房间里的怪兽制作台
data.description: 房间模型工作台前，茜戴着制作眼镜，用小打磨工具修整怪兽模型的背鳍。图纸、零件盘和盖好保护套的工具放在垫板旁，卫衣袖口收好，台灯照着她专注的侧脸。
data.action: 房间模型工作台前，茜戴着制作眼镜，用小打磨工具修整怪兽模型的背鳍
data.promptProse: Akane Shinjou wears craft glasses while smoothing the back fin of a monster model with a small sanding tool. Her lavender sweatshirt cuffs are gathered neatly above grey trousers. Drawings, a parts tray and safely covered tools sit beside the cutting mat. The medium view shows her focused profile and model contact; the task lamp illuminates the fin ridges and glasses rim, with the creature's shadow reaching across the nearby plan sheet.
